events.title: 맨체스터 시티 's victory over 왓퍼드 ensures the Maine Road side are top of the table and the only First Division side with a 100% record after three games. Their win comes despite having outfield player Bobby McDonald as goalkeeper after Joe Corrigan is rendered unavailable after just three minutes. Paul Walsh scores his first three goals for 루턴 타운 against 노츠 카운티 as the Hatters win 5–3. Bob Latchford scores three of 스완지 시티 's four without reply against 노리치 시티 , 사우샘프턴's 저스틴 파샤누 , on loan from 노팅엄 포리스트, scores the winning goal in a 1–0 victory 애스턴 빌라 , 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 and a 리버풀 win 2–0 at 아스널.

events.title: 왓퍼드, in the First Division for the first time, go top of the league on goal difference (level with 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 시티) by beating 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 3–0 in their fifth league game of the season. Ron Atkinson 's side beat 입스위치 타운 3–1 at Old Trafford . A six-goal thriller at Anfield sees 리버풀 draw 3–3 with 루턴 타운. 애스턴 빌라 beat 노팅엄 포리스트 4–1 at Villa Park . 스토크 시티 beat 스완지 시티 4–1 at the Victoria Ground . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 beat 버밍엄 시티 5–0 at Upton Park . In the Second Division, Steve Lynex and 게리 리네커 score hat-tricks in 레스터 시티's 6–0 home win over 칼라일 유나이티드 . A Yorkshire derby at Hillsborough sees 리즈 유나이티드 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 3–2.

Down in the Second Division, 미들즈브러 find themselves fifth from bottom and in real danger of a second consecutive relegation after they lose 4–0 at 울버햄프턴 원더러스 .

The gap between 리버풀 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the top of the First Division remains three points wide after 밥 페이즐리 guides his team to a 3–1 home win over 왓퍼드, and Ron Atkinson watches his side put four without reply past 노츠 카운티 at Old Trafford. 노팅엄 포리스트 revive their title challenge with a 2–1 home win over 스완지 시티.

In the Second Division promotion race, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 beat leaders QPR 4–0 at the Molineux to cut the gap between first and second place to three points. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 have a game in hand over the leaders and now have a superior goal difference.

events.title: With the 26th being on a Sunday for the last time until 1993, there are just two fixtures in the whole Football League. In the Second Division, promotion challengers 올덤 애슬레틱 and 리즈 유나이티드 draw 2–2 at Boundary Park . In the Third Division, there is a London derby at The Den , where 밀월 lose 1–0 at home to Orient in a relegation crunch match.

events.title: The last Boxing Day to fall on the 27th until 1993. 리버풀 remain in pole position at the top of the First Division with a 5–2 home win over 맨체스터 시티. There is an East Anglian derby clash at Portman Road, where 노리치 시티 boost their survival bid with a 3–2 win over their Suffolk neighbours. 버밍엄 시티 are on the winning side at home to their neighbours 애스턴 빌라, winning 3–0 to dent Tony Barton 's team's hopes of winning a second league title in three seasons, while Birmingham's three points are vital in their battle to avoid relegation. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 go top of the Second Division with a 2–0 away win over 슈루즈버리 타운 , as QPR lose 2–1 at home to London rivals 첼시 .

events.title: 1982 발롱도르
events.text: 수상 대상 연도는 1982년입니다. 정확한 발표일이 미확보되어 연말부터 공개하는 연도 단위 기록입니다. 아래 날짜를 실제 시상일로 해석하지 마세요.

events.title: 주요 이적 · 연간 기록
events.text: 연도만 확인된 역사적 이적입니다. 정확한 이적일을 만들지 않고 연말부터 공개합니다.

events.title: 1부 리그 1위 리버풀의 선두는 승점 6점으로 올라갔고, 노팅엄 포레스트가 가장 가까운 도전자였으며 왓포드와 맨체스터 유나이티드가 승점 2점 뒤처졌습니다. 선덜랜드, 버밍엄 시티, Brighton & Hove Albion이 하위 3위를 차지했습니다. 울버햄튼 원더러스에게 좋은 한 달은 미들랜드 팀이 2부 리그 정상에 오르는 모습을 보였으며, 퀸즈 파크 레인저스와 풀럼이 상위 3위 안에 들었습니다.

events.title: Alan Ball , aged 37 and the only England World Cup winner still playing, leaves 사우샘프턴 on a free transfer and signs a contract with 브리스틀 로버스 . 리버풀 are now eight points ahead at the top of the First Division after beating 노츠 카운티 5–1 at Anfield, with 맨체스터 유나이티드 now their nearest challengers after a 3–1 home win over 애스턴 빌라, while 왓퍼드 are held to a 1–1 draw at Brighton and 노팅엄 포리스트 are unable to break the deadlock in their home clash with 선덜랜드 which ends goalless. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 move closer to sealing an immediate return to the First Division by beating fellow promotion challengers 풀럼 3–1 at Craven Cottage . 슈루즈버리 타운 are now on the brink of the promotion places after a 2–0 win at home to 첼시. 더비 카운티, First Division champions eight seasons ago, are now bottom of the First Division and faced with huge debts and falling crowds.

On the domestic scene, 맨체스터 유나이티드 remain in contention for all three domestic trophies by beating 노팅엄 포리스트 4–0 in the Football League Cup quarter-final clash at Old Trafford. 토트넘 홋스퍼 suffer a shock 4–1 home defeat to Second Division strugglers 번리 in the same stage of the competition.

events.title: 1월이 끝나갈 무렵, 리버풀은 1부 리그 선두에서 승점 10점 앞서 있으며, 이들의 가장 가까운 라이벌은 현재 맨체스터 유나이티드입니다. 왓포드는 노팅엄 포레스트와 승점 동률인 3위이고, 코번트리 시티는 상위 5위 안에 들었습니다. 브라이튼 앤 호브 앨비언과 버밍엄 시티는 여전히 하위 3위에 있지만 선더랜드는 노리치 시티를 희생시키며 강등권에서 벗어났습니다. 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 퀸스 파크 레인저스 및 Fulham은 2부 리그에서 계속해서 선두를 달리고 있으며, 3위인 Fulham은 현재 가장 가까운 도전자인 Sheffield Wednesday보다 9점 앞서 있습니다. 테이블 반대편에 있는 타락한 거인 더비 카운티 County는 여전히 디비전 최하위에 머물고 있으며 현재 안전에서 8점 차이가 나기 때문에 개선의 조짐을 보이지 않습니다.

events.title: 리버풀은 Luton Town을 상대로 3-1 원정 승리를 거두며 1부 리그 선두를 12점으로 늘린 반면, 맨체스터 유나이티드는 Portman Road에서 입스위치 타운 Town을 상대로 1-1 무승부를 기록했습니다. 2부 리그에서는 울버햄프턴 원더러스, QPR, Fulham의 상위 3개 팀이 가장 가까운 도전자들과 승점 10점 이상 차이를 보이며 승격할 것이 확실해 보입니다.

events.title: 토트넘 홋스퍼 lose their first FA Cup match since March 1980, 2–0 to 에버턴 in the fifth round. 애스턴 빌라 beat 왓퍼드 4–1, while 노리치 시티 beat 입스위치 타운 1–0 in the East Anglian derby . 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 더비 카운티 1–0 at the Baseball Ground . In the First Division, 사우샘프턴 remain in the hunt for a UEFA Cup place by beating 사우샘프턴 2–0 at The Dell . 맨체스터 시티's downturn continues with a 1–0 defeat at home to 노츠 카운티.

events.title: 아스널 goalkeeper 팻 제닝스 , 37, becomes the first footballer to appear in 1,000 competitive games in England, reaching the milestone in a 0–0 league draw with 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 at The Hawthorns . 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 리버풀 draw 1–1 at Old Trafford, allowing 왓퍼드 to move into second place with a 2–1 home win over 애스턴 빌라. 노츠 카운티 move closer to securing a third successive season in the First Division by demolishing 코번트리 시티 5–1 at Meadow Lane. 선덜랜드 stay clear of the danger zone by inflicting a 3–2 defeat on 맨체스터 시티 at Roker Park . 레스터 시티 cast doubt on the seemingly certain promotion status of the Second Division's top three by beating 울버햄프턴 원더러스 5–0 at Filbert Street .
events.text: 후대 사건 기록에 근거한 회고 항목입니다. 당시 보도·초판 기사와 구분합니다.

events.title: 리버풀 now have a 14-point advantage at the top of the First Division, with 왓퍼드 one place behind and with a game in hand. 맨체스터 유나이티드, 노팅엄 포리스트 and 애스턴 빌라 complete the top five. The bottom three remain unchanged from the end of last month. 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 퀸스 파크 레인저스 and 풀럼 remain the leading force in the Second Division promotion race, but 레스터 시티 are starting to put pressure on the leading pack. In the FA Cup fifth round replays, 아스널 beat 미들즈브러 3–2 at Highbury and 번리 beat 크리스털 팰리스 1–0 at Turf Moor .
events.text: 후대 사건 기록에 근거한 회고 항목입니다. 당시 보도·초판 기사와 구분합니다.

events.title: Peter Beardsley leaves 맨체스터 유나이티드 and returns to Vancouver Whitecaps on a free transfer, having only made one appearance for the Old Trafford club. In the only First Division action of the day, Brighton win 2–1 at Swansea to draw level on points with their opponents in the battle against relegation. Second Division leaders 울버햄프턴 원더러스 at 셰필드 웬즈데이 1–0 at home.
events.text: 후대 사건 기록에 근거한 회고 항목입니다. 당시 보도·초판 기사와 구분합니다.

events.title: European action resumes with European Cup holders 애스턴 빌라 losing 2–1 at home to 유벤투스 in the quarter-final first leg, while 리버풀's hopes of a fourth European Cup triumph in seven seasons are hit hard when they go down 2–0 to Polish champions Widzew Lodz . However, 밥 페이즐리's team still look assured to retain their league title after their nearest rivals 왓퍼드 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 are both beaten away from home in the First Division, with 왓퍼드 going down 3–0 to 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road and 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 1–0 away to a 스토크 시티 side who are now pushing for UEFA Cup qualification for the first time in eight years. 에버턴 miss the chance of break into the top five when they are held to a goalless draw by 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road .

In the race for a UEFA Cup place, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 beat 입스위치 타운 4–1 at home. 맨체스터 시티, who were among the title contenders as recently as November, are now in danger of relegation after going down 4–1 at Swansea, a result which lifts the hosts out of the bottom three. An eight-goal thriller at Vicarage Road sees 왓퍼드 beat 노츠 카운티 5-3.

events.title: The First Division season ends with 왓퍼드 beating 리버풀 2–1 to finish runners-up in their first season as a First Division team. 맨체스터 유나이티드 finish third after losing 3–2 away to 노츠 카운티. 토트넘 홋스퍼 book another European campaign, this time in the UEFA Cup , with a 4–1 home win over 스토크 시티 ensuring a fourth-place finish for Keith Burkinshaw 's team. 노팅엄 포리스트 seal a return to European competitions after missing out last season by beating doomed Swansea 3–0 at the Vetch Field to fifth. The final UEFA Cup place goes to 애스턴 빌라, who beat 아스널 2–1 at Villa Park to finish sixth. 루턴 타운 pull off a remarkable escape from relegation when a late goal from Yugoslav defender Radomir Antic gives them a 1–0 away win over 맨체스터 시티 and sends the hosts down after 17 years in the First Division. 레스터 시티 seal the final promotion place in the Second Division, drawing 0–0 at home to 번리 while 풀럼 lose 1–0 at 더비 카운티 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 draw 2–2 at 울버햄프턴 원더러스. 볼턴 원더러스 are relegated from the Second Division after going down 4–1 at 찰턴 애슬레틱 in their final game of the season, as are 로더럼 유나이티드 after being held to a 2–2 draw by 리즈 유나이티드 at Elland Road . The final remaining game of the Second Division is a relegation decider between 번리 and 크리스털 팰리스 which has yet to be played. Reading and 렉섬 join 동커스터 로버스 in relegation from the Third Division. 스컨소프 유나이티드 pip Bury to the final promotion place in the Fourth Division with a 2–1 win over 체스터 시티 at Sealand Road , with the Gigg Lane side missing out on promotion after losing 3–1 at home to champions 윔블던.

events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 thrash Brighton & Hove Albion 4–0 in the FA Cup final replay to lift the trophy on legendary former manager and current director Sir 맷 버스비's 74th birthday. 브라이언 롭슨 scores twice, with 노먼 화이트사이드 becoming the youngest scorer in an FA Cup final shortly after his 18th birthday, while an Arnold Muhren penalty makes the Dutchman one of the first foreign players to score in an English cup final.
